breakdown.description: The rod is described as free to expand but the constrained-rod thermal stress formula is applied.
breakdown.reason: The original prompt created a contradiction by stating the rod was 'free to expand' but then requested a stress calculation using a formula that only applies to fully constrained conditions. The ground truth clarifies that the formula is only valid if the rod is constrained. The agent successfully resolved this by explicitly stating 'Assume the rod is fully constrained at both ends,' thereby correcting the physical premise to match the requested calculation.
